maya: Quick kickoff — short benchmark playbook for Needlepoint launch: 3 visuals, two hooks, one interactive demo.
toni: Sounds good. Keep public messaging simple and developer-first.
james: Visuals: 1) cost heatmap (QPS vs seq len -> $/1k), 2) tail-latency plot (p50/p95/p99), 3) throughput-per-dollar bars across deployment modes.
manila: Webinar: interactive slider for batch size + toggle for prefix cache so attendees can see cost impact live. Good for eng audiences. :thinking_face: 
anita: Copy angle: "Trade latency for cost with predictable levers." Avoid absolute multipliers; include appendix with methodology.
maya: Landing CTAs: "Request demo" -> Enterprise SDRs; "Try benchmark" -> Growth sandbox. Use utm_campaign=needlepoint_bench and hidden field for deployment preference.
james: benchbot snapshot: model=redwood-v1-small, qps=50, batch=8, mean=48ms, p95=210ms, cost_per_1k=0.27 (use as appendix example).
toni: Surface two qualified claims: "Typical chat: 50 QPS → ~$0.27/1k tokens, p95 <220ms" and "Batch + prefix-cache can reduce cost ~4x for batchy workloads." Mark as qualified.
manila: Segmentation: SMB messaging = cost per convo; Enterprise = SLA/fallbacks & rollout controls. Mark demo watchers as high-intent for routing experiment.
anita: I'll draft landing copy + three social snippets and 3 subject lines for A/B tests. Target EOD Thursday.
james: I'll produce chart mocks + CSVs and upload to drive with alt text.
manila: I'll vet heatmap palette for colorblind safety and advise on accessibility.
maya: Deliverables: @anita copy, @james visuals + interactive, @toni webinar script + slides. I'll assemble public one-pager + internal appendix once drafts are in. :fire:
benchbot: scheduled nightly-needlepoint run in ~24h.
